# `browser-extension/services/RuleService.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/RuleService.js`

RuleService.js — declarativeNetRequest dynamic rule manager for the OS bridge. Runs in the extension background service worker context. User-added rules use IDs >= 50000 to avoid colliding with the built-in frame-unblock rules (IDs 100-102).

- `RuleService`
